ov: Three species of tall, flat, freshwater cichlids from the Amazon, the Orinoco and rivers of the Guiana Shield in South America. Their disc-shaped, striped bodies hide them among roots and plants, where they ambush small prey. Not to be confused with the marine angelfish of coral reefs.

why.p: One of the most commonly kept freshwater aquarium fish.

rg: Tropical South America: the Amazon and Orinoco basins and rivers of the Guiana Shield.
df: Small fish and macroinvertebrates, caught by ambush.
fx: A female lays 100 to more than 1,200 eggs in a line on a leaf, log or other flat surface.
Aquarium angelfish have been selectively bred for more than 60 years, into many colour forms.
